cohort: The study cohort consisted of 145 pregnancies at delivery, including normal pregnancies and those affected by preeclampsia with and without fetal growth restriction, from which decidual tissue was assessed.
finding: Preeclampsia combined with FGR was associated with increased decidual oxidative stress and NRF2-regulated gene expression, whereas preeclampsia with normal fetal growth also showed increased decidual oxidative stress but reduced NRF2-regulated gene expression and increased KEAP1-protein expression.
